name: 语音与拍照输入
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 1a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v8a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V4a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z"/><path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2"/><line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="23"/><line x1="8" y1="23" x2="16" y2="23"/></svg>
description: 语音与拍照输入：输入框旁的 🎤 语音识别直接听写进输入框（不支持/识别失败自动降级服务端转写）；📷 摄像头现场拍照（或调起手机系统相机）直接把照片放进对话；另给 AI 一个 transcribe_audio 工具，能把工作区里的录音文件转成文字。
descriptionEn: Voice & camera input: a 🎤 button dictates into the composer (with server-side transcription as fallback), a 📷 button captures a photo from the camera (or opens the phone's camera app) straight into the chat, and the AI gets a transcribe_audio tool to turn audio files in the workspace into text.

composer.label: 语音输入
composer.hint: 点击说话，识别结果填入输入框（再点一次结束）；浮层里可随时切换浏览器联网识别 / 本地 Whisper，不必等联网失败才弹窗
composer.hintEn: Click to dictate into the input box (click again to finish); the panel lets you switch between browser recognition and local Whisper at any time

composer.label: 拍照
composer.hint: 打开摄像头拍照，照片作为附件放进输入框（手机上也可直接调起系统相机）
composer.hintEn: Capture a photo from the camera and attach it to the composer (on phones this can open the system camera app)

settings.label: 识别语言
settings.hint: 浏览器语音识别与服务端转写共用的语言
settings.hintEn: Shared language for browser speech recognition and server-side transcription

settings.label: 服务端转写降级
settings.hint: 浏览器不支持/识别失败时，录音发往服务端转写（本地 Whisper 或下面的远端接口）
settings.hintEn: When the browser can't recognize (unsupported or failed), send the recording to server-side transcription (local Whisper or the remote endpoint below)

settings.label: 给 AI 转写工具
settings.hint: 注册 transcribe_audio 工具，AI 可以把工作区里的音频文件（会议录音、语音备忘）转成文字来读；关掉即从 AI 的工具表里下架
settings.hintEn: Register the transcribe_audio tool so the AI can read workspace audio files (meeting recordings, voice memos) as text; turn off to remove it from the AI's tool list

settings.label: 转写引擎
settings.hint: 点 🎤 时直接决定先走哪条路（麦克风浮层里也能随时切，选完会存回这里）：auto=先用浏览器联网识别（免费实时），失败/不支持再降级服务端；local=直接用本地 Whisper（录音不出本机，未装会先带你装）；remote=只用远端接口。auto 与 local 在服务端转写时都是「本地优先、挂了切远端」
settings.hintEn: Decides which path the 🎤 button takes first (also switchable anytime in the mic panel; the choice is saved back here): auto = browser online recognition first (free, live), falling back to server-side on failure; local = local Whisper directly (recordings never leave this machine, installs on first use); remote = remote endpoint only. For server-side transcription, both auto and local mean "local first, remote on failure".

settings.label: 模型下载源
settings.hint: 留空 = 官方 huggingface.co。国内直连经常超时，可填社区镜像 https://hf-mirror.com ；也认环境变量 HF_ENDPOINT
settings.hintEn: Empty = official huggingface.co. Direct connections from some regions often time out; you can use the community mirror https://hf-mirror.com. The HF_ENDPOINT env var is also honored.

settings.label: 本地模型
settings.hint: base 中文更准（约 290MB）；tiny 更小更快（约 150MB），老机器选它；small 最准（约 500MB，CPU 转写慢 3~4 倍）。转写时常驻内存约 1GB。
settings.hintEn: base is more accurate for Chinese (~290MB); tiny is smaller and faster (~150MB), pick it for older machines; small is the most accurate (~500MB, 3-4x slower on CPU). Transcription keeps ~1GB resident.

settings.label: 转写接口基址
settings.hint: OpenAI 兼容基址，如 https://api.openai.com/v1；留空 = 未配置服务端转写
settings.hintEn: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1; empty = server-side transcription not configured

settings.label: 转写接口密钥
settings.hintEn: Stored in <dataDir>/plugins/voice-input/storage.json — never share screenshots of it

settings.label: 中文输出字形
settings.hint: Whisper 不分简繁体，不干预常偏繁体；这里按字形自动配 initial_prompt 纠偏
settings.hintEn: Whisper doesn't distinguish simplified/traditional and often leans traditional; this auto-tunes initial_prompt per script to correct it

settings.label: 转写提示词（initial_prompt）
settings.hint: 留空 = 按语言自动用内置提示；填了就两条引擎都用它，也可写专有名词/术语纠偏
settings.hintEn: Empty = built-in prompt picked automatically per language; when set, both engines use it. You can also put proper nouns/terms here for correction.

settings.label: 转写模型
settings.hint: 发给 /audio/transcriptions 的 model 参数
